candidates.rights_observation: FAO official pages mention CC-BY-IGO-3.0 and CC-BY-4.0 on different pages; FAO-language vocabulary content vs contributor-owned other languages must be distinguished.
candidates.proposed_usage: Candidate crop terminology only, NOT crop-specific scientific advice.

candidates.rights_observation: FAO publication default reuse is commonly framed around private study/research/teaching/noncommercial uses; specific publication, commercial adaptation/translation and third-party rights require checking.
candidates.proposed_usage: Candidate scientific literature discovery, not a verified cultivation procedure or approved model training corpus.

candidates.rights_observation: Default CC BY 4.0 where dataset metadata does not specify otherwise, with additional terms including attribution, third-party exceptions and a prohibition on enterprise/product promotion using FAO datasets.
candidates.proposed_usage: Candidate macro-statistical source to review after an owner-selected product–destination research question; not a lead, buyer, deal or redistribution permission.

candidates.rights_observation: World Bank-origin open datasets commonly use CC BY 4.0 by default with attribution, but other datasets/third-party providers have dataset-specific license restrictions; the exact dataset is not selected.
candidates.proposed_usage: Candidate statistical context for E0 only if actual question and chosen dataset rights are reviewed.

candidates.rights_observation: General UN Comtrade terms restrict redistribution and commercial use; published policy describes internal use and different redistribution exceptions or possible licenses. The combined official terms require use-case-specific legal review, not blanket permission.
candidates.proposed_usage: Candidate trade-statistics context for E0, never buyer/offer evidence; no API fetch or public product embedding authorized.
